title: Technical product owner
description:
Nova oportunidade para Technical product owner em esteio. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.  The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.  Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.  Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.  Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.   WHAT WE OFFER   Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.  Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.  Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.  Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.  Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.  An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.    OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION  At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.  We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Risk management officer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Risk management officer em valinhos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.  Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.  As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.  Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.  Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.  Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.    Requirements:   Legally resident in Brazil.  Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.  Demonstrated  independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.   Strong knowledge of  Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.   Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.  Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in  Portuguese and English  .   Must meet  fit and proper  standards with  no disqualifying factors  , including:   not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;  unblemished reputation;  knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;  technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.  not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

Sobre a Empresa O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera. Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade. Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Sobre a Função Gerir, otimizar e monetizar o portfólio energético da Arauco Brasil, incluindo autoprodução e comercialização de excedentes no mercado livre e regulado, atuando na interface entre áreas industrial, financeira e jurídica, buscando maximizar resultados econômicos por meio da gestão eficiente de contratos, análise de mercado e conformidade regulatória. Responsabilidades Gerenciar o portfólio de energia da empresa, que inclui geração, consumo, contratos livres e regulados, de curto e longo prazo, convencionais e de autoprodução; Negociar junto a traders, comercializadoras e agentes do setor a compra e venda de energia; Monitorar e analisar o mercado de energia (Preços de curto e longo prazo, oferta e demanda, cenários hidrológicos); Desenvolver estratégias de comercialização do excedente energético e otimizar a alocação de energia entre consumo próprio e venda, visando maximização de receita e redução de custos; Acompanhar e garantir conformidade com regulamentações do setor elétrico; Realizar estudos de viabilidade econômica para novos projetos energéticos (biomassa, cogeração, etc.); Atuar na gestão de riscos (crédito, exposição ao mercado de curto prazo, variação de preços); Apoiar auditorias e reportes institucionais e de sustentabilidade; Se relacionar com as instituições do setor elétrico, incluindo ANEEL, ONS, CCEE, Distribuidoras e Transmissoras de Energia; Contribuir com o planejamento orçamentário e criticar os desvios, bem como elaborar reports para o nível executivo dos resultados da área de energia; Definir com a gestão, criar e acompanhar KPIs relacionados a energia, custos e receita de energia, realizando análises e auxiliando a gestão em decisões estratégicas; Desenvolver e automatizar processos de análise de indicadores através de ferramentas avançadas (BI, Excel, ERP); Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs. Junte-se a nós na BAT e faça parte de um ambiente que prospera no crescimento interno, onde a progressão de sua carreira não é apenas uma declaração – é uma realidade que estamos ansiosos para construir juntos. Aproveite essa oportunidade e seja dono do seu desenvolvimento; seu próximo capítulo começa aqui. Você terá acesso a plataformas de aprendizagem on-line e programas de desenvolvimento personalizados para aprimorar suas habilidades de liderança Priorizamos a melhoria contínua em um ambiente transformador, preparando-nos para mudanças constantes PORQUÊ JUNTAR-SE À BAT? Somos uma das poucas empresas nomeadas como Global Top Employer pelo Top Employers Institute - certificada em oferecer excelentes condições aos colaboradores. A colaboração, a inclusão e a parceria estão na base de tudo o que fazemos na BAT. Estamos ansiosos pra proporcionar que cada indivíduo prospere, independentemente do género, orientação sexual, estado civil, mudança de género, raça, religião ou crença, cor, nacionalidade, origem étnica ou nacional, deficiência, idade, competências, experiência, educação, contexto socioeconómico e profissional, estatuto de veterano, perspectivas e estilos de pensamento. Sabemos que abraçar talentos de todas as origens é o que nos torna mais fortes e melhor preparados para atingir os nossos objectivos empresariais. Encaramos as interrupções de carreira como oportunidades e não como obstáculos. Através do programa The Global Returners, apoiamos os profissionais que procuram reiniciar as suas carreiras após uma ausência prolongada da força de trabalho (por exemplo, tempo para cuidar da família, licença parental, serviço nacional, licença sabática e/ou iniciar um empreendimento próprio). Venha trazer a sua diferença e veja o que é possível para você na BAT. Saiba mais sobre a nossa cultura e a nossa premiada experiência para os funcionários. Se necessitar de quaisquer ajustes ou adaptações razoáveis para ajudar a ter o melhor desempenho possível durante o processo de recrutamento, encorajamos você a nos notificar. Estamos totalmente empenhados em apoiá-lo, tomando as medidas adequadas para que possa demonstrar todo o seu potencial.

title: Senior data engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior data engineer em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Senior Data Engineer We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. You will work hands on with Python, Py Spark, Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Gitbased workflows and CI/CD to support end to end delivery through Azure Dev Ops. Responsibilities Design, develop and optimize ETL ELT pipelines using Databricks, Py Spark to ingest, transform and serve data for digital customer experience. Build and maintain highquality performant SQL transformations and dimensional curated data layers for analytics and downstream consumption. Implement best practices for Databricks engineering notebooks vs repos modular code cluster job configuration, performance tuning and cost awareness. Use Python for data processing utilities validations orchestration helpers and reusable libraries. Manage source control using Git with enterprise workflows across Git Hub Bitbucket enforce PR reviews branching strategies and coding standards. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure Dev Ops automating testing packaging and deployment of data code artifacts across environments. Ensure data quality and reliability through validations reconciliation, checks monitoring and operational runbooks. Collaborate with product app teams analysts and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable data products aligned to customer experience journeys. For Senior Developer lead module level design, mentor engineers drive standards for CI/CD and code quality and own delivery for critical pipelines. Requirements Strong handson experience with: Python, Py Spark, Databricks, jobs workflows, clusters repos, SQL advanced querying optimization. Strong experience with Git and repository platforms, Git Hub and/or Bitbucket. Hands on experience implementing CI/CD for data engineering workloads. Strong working experience with Azure Dev Ops, Boards Repos Pipelines, build release workflows. English for reading, writing and verbal communication directly with foreigners. If this sounds like the next challenge for you, apply now with an updated resume in English and we'll take it from here :)

title: Designer elétrico
description:
Empresa está contratando Designer elétrico em arujá. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

A Roeslein Brasil abrange mais de 9.000 metros quadrados e é responsável pela fabricação de uma série de equipamentos especializados, incluindo transportadores, sistemas de biogás, skids de petróleo e gás e soluções industriais modulares. A equipe de São Paulo possui expertise profissional em uma ampla gama de serviços avançados de manufatura, incluindo corte a laser, prensagem, soldagem e sistemas de pintura eletrostática. Se você se identifica com o nosso ethos – ser sempre humilde, estar sempre disposto e feliz – confira a vaga disponível abaixo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe! Atuação: 100% Presencial Região de Atuação: Arujá/SP Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à quinta-feira das 07h às 17h (com 1h para refeição) e sexta-feira das 07h às 16h (com 1h para refeição) Modelo de Trabalho: CLT RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO: Responsável pelo desenvolvimento de projetos elétricos e de automação industrial, incluindo painéis de controle, sistemas de instrumentação e infraestrutura elétrica. Atuará na elaboração da documentação técnica do projeto, desde as fases conceitual e básica até o detalhamento para fabricação e instalação, garantindo conformidade com normas técnicas, especificações de clientes e boas práticas da engenharia. O profissional também apoiará atividades de campo, integração com equipes de engenharia e suporte técnico durante fabricação, montagem e testes de painéis e equipamentos. DEVERES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS: Desenvolver projetos elétricos de painéis de controle e sistemas de automação industrial, garantindo conformidade com requisitos técnicos e especificações do cliente. Elaborar e manter documentação técnica de engenharia, incluindo: Listas de I/O; Diagramas elétricos e diagramas de interligação; Listas de cabos; Listas de materiais (BOM); Arquiteturas de redes de automação; Especificações técnicas de painéis de controle e sistemas associados. Projetar e especificar componentes elétricos e de automação, incluindo circuitos de segurança, módulos de entrada e saída (I/O), redes industriais e sistemas de controle. Realizar Especificação da infraestrutura elétrica, incluindo eletrodutos, eletrocalhas, leitos de cabos, suportações e demais elementos de instalação. Assegurar que os projetos estejam em conformidade com normas técnicas aplicáveis, especificações contratuais e padrões internos de engenharia. Prestar suporte técnico às áreas de montagem, fabricação e comissionamento, esclarecendo dúvidas técnicas, revisando documentação e apoiando a correta implementação dos projetos. CONHECIMENTO / HABILIDADE / EDUCAÇÃO / EXPERIÊNCIA: Curso Técnico em Automação, Elétrica ou áreas correlatas. Desejável: 2 (dois) anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de projetos industriais nas áreas de automação e controle e vivência na elaboração e detalhamento de projetos elétricos e de automação, incluindo documentação técnica e suporte às etapas de fabricação e implementação. OUTROS ATRIBUTOS DESEJÁVEIS: Experiência na criação e desenvolvimento de layouts de painéis elétricos e de automação. Experiência com CLPs e inversores de frequência das plataformas Rockwell (Allen-Bradley) e/ou Siemens. Experiência com Auto CAD Electrical para desenvolvimento de diagramas e documentação técnica. Conhecimento em redes industriais, como Ether Net/IP, Profinet ou protocolos similares. BENEFÍCIOS Na Roeslein, investimos no sucesso e no bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores. Abaixo estão os benefícios oferecidos: Assistência médica (cobertura apartamento) e odontológica Seguro de Vida Vale refeição/alimentação (R$60,00 por dia útil) Incentivos para educação, com reembolsos para cursos de idiomas, cursos técnicos, graduações e especializações Incentivos para saúde física, com totalpass, reembolsos anuais de academia e reembolsos por corridas de ruas Programa de bônus Gratificação em viagens corporativas

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Confira a vaga para Marketing ai agent builder em caxias do sul. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

Serão considerados apenas currículos que atendam aos seguintes critérios: 1. DESCRIÇÃO DETALHADA DA EXPERIÊNCIA TÉCNICA O candidato deve apresentar, para cada experiência profissional relevante: Nome da empresa Período de atuação Cargo ocupado Descrição objetiva das atividades executadas, com foco em: Apuração de tributos (Simples Nacional, Lucro Presumido e Lucro Real) Participação ativa em fechamentos fiscais mensais Revisões críticas, validações e análises de apuração tributária Entregas de obrigações acessórias (SPEDs, ECF, ECD, etc.) Conciliações fiscais e contábeis Identificação de inconsistências, riscos fiscais e ajustes necessários Interação com clientes ou áreas internas em temas fiscais relevantes Não serão considerados currículos com descrições genéricas, superficiais ou sem evidência de atuação prática. 2. COMPROVAÇÃO DE ATUAÇÃO PRÁTICA O currículo deve deixar evidente: Nível de autonomia na execução das rotinas fiscais Participação direta em fechamentos fiscais completos Complexidade das empresas atendidas (porte, volume de operações, regimes tributários) Envolvimento em revisões técnicas, validações ou análises críticas Atuação na identificação e tratamento de riscos fiscais 3. REFERÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS (OBRIGATÓRIO) O candidato deverá informar, no mínimo, 3 referências profissionais diretas, vinculadas à sua atuação técnica. Cada referência deve conter obrigatoriamente: Nome da empresa Nome completo do contato Cargo do contato Relação profissional com o candidato (ex: gestor direto, sócio, cliente, líder técnico, etc.) E-mail corporativo Telefone para contato As referências poderão ser contatadas durante o processo seletivo para validação técnica, nível de autonomia e qualidade das entregas realizadas. 4. Não buscamos profissionais com atuação apenas operacional ou suporte parcial. Buscamos profissionais com capacidade de analisar, revisar, validar e sustentar tecnicamente as apurações fiscais, atuando como referência dentro do time e junto aos clientes. Currículos que não atendam aos critérios acima poderão ser desconsiderados automaticamente.

title: Senior voip engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior voip engineer em santa cruz do sul. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the role  We are hiring a  Senior Vo IP Engineer  to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).  Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.  Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Empresa está contratando Marketing ai agent builder em caraguatatuba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing) em barretos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses). The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.  The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.  Financial   ● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.  ● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.  ● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates  ● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.  ● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients  ● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients  ● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions  Operational   ● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.  ● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.  ● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.  ● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.  Experience and Skills   ● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.  ● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance  ● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.  ● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.  ● Knowledge of ERP systems, Net Suite a plus  ● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.  ● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

Sobre a empresa  Prazer, somos a FHOM Alimentos Saudáveis, uma empresa familiar, com 32 anos de mercado fabricando alimentos puros e saudáveis. Para quem ainda não sabe, o nome FHOM tem origem nas primeiras letras do nome do casal fundador e seus filhos.  Estamos presentes em todos os estados brasileiros, em mais de 5 mil pontos de venda, alcançando cada vez mais destaque nos segmentos de snacks saudáveis, orgânicos e FREE FROM.  Temos como base de trabalho 3 grandes frentes onde nos baseamos para todas as decisões, são elas:  QUALIDADE / PESSOAS / INOVAÇÃ O  Atualmente o parque industrial tem 8.500m2 e 70 colaboradores diretos e mais de 100 indiretos.  Os produtos da FHOM são reconhecidos pela alta qualidade e sabores deliciosos de seus produtos.  A FHOM prima por utilizar apenas ingredientes naturais e sem nenhum aditivo químico, comprados em sua maioria de pequenos produtores orgânicos e convencionais e tratados como se fossem da família.  Todo nosso processo é certificado por auditorias onde temos uma fabricação extremamente sofisticada porém, sem deixar de ser um produto artesanal.  Atualmente possuímos os selos SVB, Orgânico, e Kosher.  A linha Bem Orgânico é o braço orgânico da FHOM Alimentos, que desde 2013 produz e é pioneiro na fabricação de batatas chips orgânicas do Brasil.  Acreditamos e trabalhamos para que todos os envolvidos, desde o produtor rural até o consumidor final dos nossos produtos, estejam felizes e satisfeitos.  Assim, teremos certeza de que realizamos nossa tarefa da melhor maneira possível e que ela valeu a pena. title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Commercial lead — brazil em santa catarina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas. title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Commercial lead — brazil em agudos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.  Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.  Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.  Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior business analyst - supply chain em criciúma. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior business analyst - supply chain em esteio. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local. Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil. Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil. Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala. description:

Sobre a empresaPrazer, somos a FHOM Alimentos Saudáveis, uma empresa familiar, com 32 anos de mercado fabricando alimentos puros e saudáveis. Para quem ainda não sabe, o nome FHOM tem origem nas primeiras letras do nome do casal fundador e seus filhos. Estamos presentes em todos os estados brasileiros, em mais de 5 mil pontos de venda, alcançando cada vez mais destaque nos segmentos de snacks saudáveis, orgânicos e FREE FROM. Temos como base de trabalho 3 grandes frentes onde nos baseamos para todas as decisões, são elas: QUALIDADE / PESSOAS / INOVAÇÃO Atualmente o parque industrial tem 8.500m2 e 70 colaboradores diretos e mais de 100 indiretos. Os produtos da FHOM são reconhecidos pela alta qualidade e sabores deliciosos de seus produtos. A FHOM prima por utilizar apenas ingredientes naturais e sem nenhum aditivo químico, comprados em sua maioria de pequenos produtores orgânicos e convencionais e tratados como se fossem da família. Todo nosso processo é certificado por auditorias onde temos uma fabricação extremamente sofisticada porém, sem deixar de ser um produto artesanal. Atualmente possuímos os selos SVB, Orgânico, e Kosher. A linha Bem Orgânico é o braço orgânico da FHOM Alimentos, que desde 2013 produz e é pioneiro na fabricação de batatas chips orgânicas do Brasil. Acreditamos e trabalhamos para que todos os envolvidos, desde o produtor rural até o consumidor final dos nossos produtos, estejam felizes e satisfeitos. Assim, teremos certeza de que realizamos nossa tarefa da melhor maneira possível e que ela valeu a pena. ResponsabilidadesPlanejar, programar e controlar a produção, garantindo o atendimento da demanda com eficiência Elaborar e acompanhar o forecast de produção junto ao comercialo (PMP) Gerenciar níveis de estoque de matérias-primas e produtos acabados Analisar capacidade produtiva e propor melhorias de fluxo Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (OTIF, giro de estoque, lead time, etc.) Atuar em conjunto com compras, logística e produção para alinhamento de demandas Identificar gargalos e propor soluções para otimização de processos  RequisitosFormação em Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas Experiência sólida em PCP, preferencialmente na indústria de alimentos ou bens de consumo Conhecimento no sistemas ERP TOTVS Protheus Excel avançado (desejável conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas) Experiência com controle de estoque e planejamento de demanda Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa capacidade de comunicação  DiferenciaisExperiência no segmento de alimentos saudáveis ou perecíveis Vivência em ambientes com alta variabilidade de demanda  Nível da vagaPleno ou Sênior (de acordo com experiência e senioridade do candidato) Benefícios(Preencher conforme política da empresa) Vale alimentação/refeição Vale transporte Convênio Farmácia PLR (Outros benefícios)  Por que trabalhar com a gente?Aqui você fará parte de uma empresa em crescimento, com propósito claro de promover saúde através da alimentação, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

title: Analista de incorporação pleno
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista de incorporação pleno em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Muito mais do que uma incorporadora e construtora – realizamos sonhos e transformamos vidas! Somos movidos por resultados e vivemos um momento de crescimento acelerado, com grandes lançamentos previstos e metas ainda mais ambiciosas para os próximos anos. Se você busca desafios e quer liderar a transformação em uma empresa inovadora e em expansão, essa oportunidade é para você ! O que você fará por aqui: Acompanhar os prazos de desenvolvimento e lançamento de empreendimentos, elaborando e controlando os cronogramas do produto desde a concepção até o lançamento; Participar do desenvolvimento de novos produtos com base em pesquisas de mercado, análise da concorrência, informações comerciais e estudos de viabilidade, em parceria com áreas internas e fornecedores externos; Acompanhar e apoiar a obtenção de documentações e aprovações necessárias junto a órgãos federais, estaduais e municipais para viabilização dos empreendimentos; Monitorar o desenvolvimento dos projetos, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos pela empresa; Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Marketing e Inteligência de Mercado na criação de briefings e no acompanhamento das campanhas de lançamento dos empreendimentos; Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de materiais de divulgação, ilustrações, maquetes e demais peças utilizadas nas campanhas de lançamento; Participar da implantação e acompanhamento de stands de vendas, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e custos; Desenvolver materiais de apoio para treinamento de corretores e argumentação de vendas, considerando os diferenciais competitivos do empreendimento; Apoiar ações promocionais e eventos comerciais, além de contribuir para revisões de campanhas com foco em alavancagem de vendas; Contribuir para estudos de viabilidade econômica dos empreendimentos, acompanhando orçamentos de marketing e incorporação; Elaborar materiais e fornecer informações para o Memorial de Incorporação, acompanhando prazos e etapas do processo; Apoiar processos relacionados à contratação de NBR, estimativa de custos de condomínio junto às administradoras e estudos de permuta de terrenos; Garantir a conservação dos terrenos em estoque, apoiando ações preventivas para evitar riscos ou atrasos nos lançamentos; Preparar a Ficha Resumo do Empreendimento (FRE) e apoiar o departamento de Captação de Recursos na montagem dos processos de pré-análise dos empreendimentos. O que esperamos que você tenha: Ensino superior completo em Arquitetura, Engenharia Civil, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas; Experiência em processos de incorporação imobiliária e desenvolvimento de empreendimentos; Vivência no acompanhamento de cronogramas de produto e etapas de lançamento de empreendimentos; Experiência no acompanhamento de aprovações e documentações junto a órgãos públicos; Conhecimento sobre Memorial de Incorporação e documentação necessária para registro de empreendimentos; Experiência na interface com áreas como Projetos, Marketing, Comercial, Jurídico e Inteligência de Mercado; Vivência no acompanhamento de campanhas de lançamento, materiais de vendas e stands de vendas; Excel intermediário ou avançado. Seria incrível se você tivesse: Experiência prévia em incorporadoras ou construtoras; Experiência com montagem de processos de pré-análise de empreendimentos e elaboração de FRE (Ficha Resumo do Empreendimento); Conhecimento em definição de produto imobiliário e posicionamento de mercado; Experiência no relacionamento com cartórios, administradoras de condomínio e fornecedores do setor imobiliário. Benefícios que refletem o nosso jeito de cuidar Na Plano&Plano, acreditamos que cada conquista é construída junto. Por isso, nossos benefícios foram pensados para apoiar você em todas as fases da jornada, no trabalho, em casa e na vida. Essenciais para o dia a dia: Vale-refeição no cartão Flash: liberdade total para escolher onde e como usar; Vale-transporte ou fretado: com desconto de até 6%, garantindo mais mobilidade e praticidade; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): porque o sucesso é coletivo e celebramos juntos cada conquista!. Saúde e bem-estar em primeiro lugar: Assistência Médica Bradesco Saúde: cobertura nacional para cuidar de você; Assistência odontológica Bradesco (opcional): um sorriso saudável também faz parte da nossa rotina; Seguro de Vida Met Life: tranquilidade e proteção para você; Wellhub (Gympass): equilíbrio entre corpo e mente com acesso a academias, terapias e programas de bem-estar; Cartão Natalidade: para celebrar esse momento tão especial com mais tranquilidade. Qualidade de vida que inspira Day Off de Aniversário: um dia de folga para você celebrar do seu jeito; Emendas de feriados e recesso de fim de ano: tempo extra para descansar e recarregar as energias, sem desconto das férias. Vantagens que vão além Desconto especial na compra do seu apartamento Plano&Plano: o sonho da casa própria pode começar aqui!; Outras informações Local: escritório próximo ao metrô Butantã, em São Paulo; Jornada: segunda a sexta-feira, presencial, porque acreditamos que conexões reais constroem grandes resultados.
